evidence.locator: 737 x 737 px over 33.3 × 33.3 arcsec; WFPC2: H-alpha 656 nm in green, [N II] 658 nm in red and [O I] 631 nm in magenta, as ESA's page lists them; released 17 December 1997. The file's embedded sky tags for scale and direction, 0.0452 arcsec per pixel and north 106.92° right of vertical, and the central star for place: its peak, pixel 361.0, 350.6, is set at the star's Gaia EDR3 place, so the frame's centre is 351.4740504°, 42.53509°. The tags alone put the star 0.32 arcsec from there.
